metadata.title: Vietcombank exchange-rate snapshots for 2026-08-06
metadata.unit: VND per 1 unit of foreign currency
metadata.scope: Consolidation of intraday snapshots found on the public web. Observed snapshots are kept separate from hourly reconstructed USD/VND values.
metadata.important_note: Vietcombank's public page does not expose a complete public intraday event history. Therefore, records marked observed/partial_observed come from timestamped public snapshots or reporting that quoted Vietcombank at that time. Records marked reconstructed_locf are estimates using the last observed price level and must not be presented as direct VCB snapshots.

validation_notes: Do not treat usd_vnd_hourly_reconstruction as raw tick data.
The most reliable complete multi-currency snapshot found for the day is 09:30.
The 06:00/12:00/18:00 records come from a site that explicitly says it stores snapshots from Vietcombank's exchangerates API on that schedule.
Secondary news sources were used only when they stated a survey/publication time and explicitly quoted Vietcombank.
No public source found during this check exposed every Vietcombank intraday update event for 2026-08-06.
The exact transition time between the 08:00 and 09:00 USD levels is unknown; it occurred sometime after the 08:00 observation and by 09:00.
The exact transition time between the 12:00 and 13:52 USD levels is unknown; it occurred sometime after the 12:00 observation and by 13:52.
Hours after 18:00 are reconstructed from the last observed 18:00 level; a later overnight change before 07/08 06:00 cannot be ruled out.
